title: Chemi-Proteome Language Attention Network Empowers Fragment-Based Ligand Interactome and Binding Sites Discovery with Evidence
summary: Beyond retrospective benchmarks, the primary preprint reports a new ligand advanced into a cellularly active SIRT3 probe. This is probe evidence, not therapeutic efficacy.
ai_technology: C-PLANK embeddings and bilinear attention network
organization: City University of Hong Kong; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Ruijin Hospital
